name: Comprehensive version tracking
description: Implement version tracking across all FADE artifacts with public gist-based version manifest, individual file versioning, release version coordination, and automatic version output for troubleshooting. Enables users to identify version drift and simplifies debugging across projects.

userStories.title: Create public version manifest gist
userStories.description: As a FADE maintainer, I want a public GitHub gist containing the version manifest, so that the CLI can check versions without requiring repo access.
acceptanceCriteria: Public gist created at a stable URL
Gist contains JSON manifest with: release version, and each artifact with its individual version
Manifest structure: { release: '0.4.0', artifacts: { 'fade-cli': '0.4.0', 'prompt.md': '0.4.0', 'FADE.md': '0.4.0', ... } }
Gist URL added as constant in fade-cli
README documents the gist location and manifest format

userStories.title: Add version headers to all FADE artifacts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want each FADE artifact to contain its own version header, so that I can identify the version of any individual file.
acceptanceCriteria: fade-cli: FADE_VERSION already exists, add ARTIFACT_VERSION='0.4.0' constant
prompt.md: <!-- FADE prompt.md v0.4.0 --> at top of file
FADE.md template: <!-- FADE FADE.md v0.4.0 --> at top of file
CLAUDE.md template: <!-- FADE CLAUDE.md v0.4.0 --> at top of file
learned.md template: <!-- FADE learned.md v0.4.0 --> at top of file
progress.md template: <!-- FADE progress.md v0.4.0 --> at top of file
Version format is consistent: <!-- FADE {filename} v{version} -->

userStories.title: fade init stamps versions into generated files
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade init to stamp the current CLI version into all generated files, so that projects track which version created their artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: fade init replaces __VERSION__ placeholder with $FADE_VERSION in all templates
Generated FADE.md contains <!-- FADE FADE.md v{version} -->
Generated prompt.md contains <!-- FADE prompt.md v{version} -->
Generated CLAUDE.md contains <!-- FADE CLAUDE.md v{version} -->
Generated learned.md contains <!-- FADE learned.md v{version} -->
Generated progress.md contains <!-- FADE progress.md v{version} -->

userStories.title: fade version shows detailed version info
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade version to show both CLI version and detected artifact versions in the current project, so that I can quickly identify version drift.
acceptanceCriteria: fade version (no args) shows CLI version (existing behaviour preserved)
fade version --all shows CLI version plus all detected artifact versions
Scans current project for FADE artifacts and extracts version headers
Shows 'not found' for missing artifacts, 'no version' for artifacts without headers
Output format: CLI: v0.4.0, prompt.md: v0.4.0, FADE.md: v0.3.0 (outdated), etc.
Highlights version mismatches with yellow colour

userStories.title: fade status outputs version info
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade status to show version information by default, so that I always know what versions I'm working with.
acceptanceCriteria: fade status header shows CLI version (already does: 'FADE v0.3.0')
fade status footer shows artifact versions if any are outdated
If all versions match: no extra output (clean)
If versions differ: shows warning with list of outdated artifacts
fade status --json includes versions object in output

userStories.title: Version output after FADE component changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade update to output version changes clearly, so that I can see what was updated.
acceptanceCriteria: fade update shows before/after versions for each updated artifact
Format: 'prompt.md: v0.3.0 → v0.4.0'
Summary line: 'Updated 3 artifacts to v0.4.0'
If nothing to update: 'All artifacts at v0.4.0'

userStories.title: fade run outputs version banner
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade run to output version info at session start, so that troubleshooting always has version context.
acceptanceCriteria: fade run outputs version banner before launching Claude Code
Banner shows: CLI version, prompt.md version, any version warnings
Banner is concise (2-3 lines max when all versions match)
fade yolo also shows version banner
Version info captured in session context for Claude Code

userStories.title: fade update checks gist for latest versions
userStories.description: As a developer, I want fade update to check the public gist for the latest version manifest, so that updates work without GitHub repo access.
acceptanceCriteria: fade update fetches version manifest from public gist
Compares local artifact versions against manifest
Downloads updated artifacts from gist or raw GitHub URLs
Falls back to current GitHub raw URLs if gist unavailable
Timeout handling for network issues
